business.missing_value: Row {row} has no value for {column}. Missing values are not treated as zero; complete the source file.
business.invalid_number: Row {row}, field {column}, contains an ambiguous number. Use a decimal point and no thousands separators for this dataset.
business.negative_component: Row {row}, field {column}, is negative. This dataset records refunds as positive deductions; agree a separate adjustment policy.
business.duplicate_key: A source key is duplicated. Remove the duplicate or clarify the grain; duplicate rows cannot be silently summed.
business.currency: Every row must use RUB. Mixed currencies require an agreed exchange-rate source.
business.zero_denominator: The denominator for {metric} is zero or negative. The percentage is unavailable; absolute totals are preserved.
business.plan_key_missing: Some actual rows have no matching plan key. Complete the plan by month, region and product.
business.plan_grain: The plan grain is month, region and product, without channel. Aggregate actuals first and count each plan key once.
business.incomplete_cohort: The compared periods contain different segment cohorts. Restore comparable coverage first.
business.incomplete_period: Period {period} is incomplete and cannot be presented as a full-quarter comparison.
business.period_missing: Period {period} is missing. Both complete periods are required.
business.period: Row {row} has an invalid month. Use YYYY-MM.
business.period_limit: This calculation supports at most 120 months. Narrow the reporting period.
business.unknown_key: Value {value} in {column} is absent from the dictionary. Correct the table relationship.
business.dictionary: Each dictionary entry needs a string identifier and a full name.
business.missing_key: Row {row} has an incomplete key. Provide month, region, product and, for sales, channel.
business.invalid_row: Row {row} does not match the table format.
business.row_limit: Provide a nonempty table of no more than 100,000 rows.
business.number_limit: The numbers exceed the safe range for this calculation. Clarify units and scale without losing precision.
business.orders_integer: The order count in row {row} must be an integer.
business.view_refused: View {view} could not be built: {reason}. Changing the chart cannot bypass input restrictions.
business.unknown: Calculation stopped. Check the source data and request parameters.
view.kpi: KPIs show totals for the closed quarter. Margin is calculated separately as profit divided by revenue.
view.trend: Lines show ordered months and changing totals. Revenue and profit are in RUB excluding VAT.
view.comparison: Bars compare each segment's absolute contribution to revenue change. A negative value means a decline from the previous quarter.
view.table: The table compares exact product totals. Full source rows remain available separately; these are not tariff-option sales.
